{{Quote|And we're already being pulled toward the collapsing nebula!|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]|<ref name="Terror on the Twilight" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], this '''nebula''' was on the verge of collapsing. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] set up a [[Mission to the Deyvus|trap]] for [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] near the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]].
